s: secondhand, (usually more specifically) acquired at a second-hand shop
Ist das Kleid neu oder secondhand?
Is that dress new or secondhand?
secondhand.et: Borrowed from English secondhand. Compare Romanian second-hand and Russian сѐконд-хе́нд (sèkond-xénd).

sechzehn.et: From Middle High German seh(s)zehen, from Old High German seh(s)zehan, from Proto-Germanic *sehstehun. Equivalent to sechs + zehn. Compare Dutch zestien, West Frisian sechstjin, English sixteen, Danish seksten.

sechzig.et: From Middle High German seh(s)zec, from Old High German sehszug, from Proto-Germanic *sehs tigiwiz. Equivalent to sechs + -zig.

sechste.et: From Old High German sehsto, from Proto-Germanic *sehstô. Equivalent to sechs + -te.

s: A failing grade in a class or course at school. The grades range from 1 (best) to 6 (worst).
an engine with six cylinders; six-cylinder engine
Den Chevrolet Equinox gibt es auch mit einem Sechszylinder.
The Chevrolet Equinox is also available with a six-cylinder engine.
a car with a six-cylinder engine
His grandfather drives a car with a six-cylinder-engine.
Die zweyte Regel: Den sechsten Fall (den Ablativus) regieren folgende zehn [Vorwörter]: […]
(please add an English translation of this quotation)

something with a number, value or size of six
ein Sechzehneck ist ein Vieleck mit sechzehn Seiten
a hexadecagon is a sixteen-sided polygon
Calculate the surface area of a hexagonal pyramid.
a polygon that has sixty vertices and sixty edges; a sixty-sided polygon
coulter (knife on a plough, fixed in front of the ploughshare)
Sech.et: From Middle High German sech, from Old High German seh, from Proto-West Germanic [Term?], derived from Latin secare (“to cut off”).

s: triacontahexagon: a thirty-six-sided polygon, a polygon with 36 vertices

Secondhandshop.et: Unadapted borrowing from English second-hand shop.

sechstjüngst.et: From sechste + jung, with jung put into the superlative form jüngst.

sechstältest.et: From sechste + alt, with alt put into the superlative form ältest.

s: Zum Beispiel dem in Dänemark geborenen iranischen Secondo Atila Momeni: Als er beim Klub nachfragte, was denn los sei, wurde ihm mitgeteilt, sein Ticketkauf sei aus Sicherheitsgründen annulliert worden.
a six-year-old (male or of unspecified gender)
a sixteen-year-old (male or of unspecified gender)
a twenty-six-year-old (male or of unspecified gender)
a thirty-six-year-old (male or of unspecified gender)
Er war Dekan der Philosophischen Fakultät … und wurde nach seiner Emeritierung im Jahre 1956 in das sechsundzwanzigköpfige „Nationalkomitee der Historiker der DDR“ berufen.
A village, officially a quarter of Bornheim, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany.
Sechtem.et: From Middle High German Sephteme, probably from Latin septima (“seventh”) in a supposed ad septimam leugam (“at the seventh league”), the place being roughly seven Roman leagues (a bit over 15 km) away from Bonn. The sound shift pt → ft through Primärberührung…

Sechsfüßer.et: From sechs (“six”) + Fuß (“foot”) + -er (“er”). Calque of translingual Hexapoda.

s: a requiem mass held about forty days after a person’s death
Sechswochenamt.et: From sechs (“six”) + Wochen (“weeks”) + Amt (“mass”, literally “service, office”).

Secondhandladen.et: From second-hand + Laden; adapted borrowing from English second-hand shop.
